subject.title: fix(google): support GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID for Vertex AI

question: Should OpenClaw accept `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as a supported Google Vertex project alias across auth evidence and runtime project resolution?
rationale: The code path is coherent and proven, but repository policy treats env/config and auth-provider surfaces as high-bar compatibility decisions, and upstream `@google/genai` only reads `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` from env by default.

options.title: Accept the additive alias
options.body: Land after normal exact-head gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller auth-evidence-only or docs/precedence-adjusted version if provider owners do not want runtime recognition expanded yet.

options.title: Reject the alias
options.body: Close or request removal if maintainers want Vertex behavior to stay aligned with upstream SDK env names only.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive alias
recommendation.body: Land after normal exact-head gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Google Vertex ADC and credential-surface work plus earlier production ADC merge history make this the best available owner for the env-surface decision.
